title: Permit
description: Capability lease issued by AtlaSent when a decision is 'allow'. A permit is a time-bounded, revocable, optionally renewable authority artifact — the unit of access in the continuous-authorization model. The evaluate-response carries flat permit_* fields for v1.x compatibility; this schema is the canonical internal record shape and the shape returned by GET /v1/permits/:id.

token.description: Opaque bearer token. Treat as a secret; do not log.

expires_at.description: Absolute expiry. The permit is invalid after this time regardless of lease state.

lease_expires_at.description: Continuous-authorization lease expiry. Null when renewable is false. Advances on each successful POST /v1/permits/:id/renew. A renewable permit is only valid if both expires_at and lease_expires_at are in the future.

max_lease_duration_ms.description: Maximum duration of a single lease renewal window in milliseconds, bounded by expires_at. Null when renewable is false.

renewable.description: Whether this permit supports continuous-authorization lease renewal. When true, SDK guards should configure permitRevalidationIntervalMs (PROD-D9) to poll GET /v1/permits/:id/valid and renew via POST /v1/permits/:id/renew.

revocation_scope.description: The scope pattern that a POST /v1/revoke-scope call would match to revoke this permit. Derived from action_class at issuance. Used by the PROD-D9 sweep materializer to join scope_revocations against active permits.

revocation_id.description: ID of the scope_revocations row that caused this permit to be revoked. Populated by the sweep materializer.

delegation_id.description: The delegation record that authorized this permit, if the evaluation was for a delegated actor.

oneOf.description: Ordered delegation hops from originating principal to executing actor, captured immutably at permit issuance. Index 0 is the top-level grant.
